t: Trump Says He Will Discuss Denuclearization With Putin, Xi Jinping in China
d: US President Donald Trump said that he would discuss denuclearization during a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in China.

t: Trump Believes Ukraine May Have 'Little Bit Different Shape' After Peace Deal
d: US President Donald Trump said that Ukraine might "end up with a little bit different shape" as part of a peace settlement.

t: Rubio Says US, Iran Not Yet on Verge of Resolving Their Conflict
d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the United States and Iran were not yet on the verge of resolving their conflict.

t: Finnish, Norwegian Leaders' Call to Putin Exposed Deep Divisions Within Europe - Media
d: When Finland’s President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian PM Jonas Gahr Store called Vladimir Putin, they hoped such a direct intervention with Russia’s leader would “demonstrate European resolve,” according to Western media reports.

t: Russian Army Strikes Industrial and Energy Facilities Used by Ukrainian Forces
d: The Russian armed forces struck an electrical substation in the area of the village of Belaya Tserkov in the Kiev region, the Russian Defense Ministry said.

t: Rubio Hopes to See Progress on Ukrainian Settlement at Abu Dhabi Talks
d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed his hope that progress on the Ukrainian settlement can be achieved during the talks in Abu Dhabi.

t: Zelensky's Critics Vanish Into Ukrainian Secret Prisons - Source
d: Critics of Vladimir Zelensky's end up at secret torture sites, which Ukraine uses as an instrument of reprisal, a source in the resistance movement in Odessa told Sputnik.

t: EU Seeks to Replenish Ukraine's Huge Military Losses by Forcing Men Back Home - Russian Intel
d: The EU leadership is actively exploring ways to push Ukrainian men living in Europe back to their homeland, Russia's Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR) stated.

t: Russia's Rassvet Satellite Constellation Protected From External Impact - Shoigu
d: The Rassvet satellite constellation designed by Russian aerospace company Bureau 1440 is fully protected from physical, political and economic impact, Russian Security Council Secretary Sergei Shoigu said on Monday.

t: Russia, US Oppose Increasing OSCE’s Budget — Diplomat
d: Russia and the United States oppose increasing funding for the OSCE, Russian Permanent Representative to the OSCE Dmitry Polyansky said.

t: Russia Forces Liberate Vasylkovoye Settlement in Zaporozhye Region
d: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - The Russian armed forces have liberated the settlement of Vasylkovoye in the Zaporozhye region, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Monday.

t: Abu Dhabi Talks Planned Without Europeans - Kremlin
d: Talks in Abu Dhabi are planned without European participation, Peskov said — Russia and Ukraine will meet there with US mediation, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said.

t: Rossiya Segodnya Hosts Session as Part of the Peoples of Russia Forum
d: As part of the Peoples of Russia International Week held at the World Trade Center in Moscow, the Rossiya Segodnya International Media Group hosted a discussion titled “Russia’s Voice Abroad: Soft Power with a Firm Character”.

t: Russia’s Bridge Strikes Aim to Paralyze Logistics Sustaining Ukraine’s Military - Expert
d: Russian strikes target critical arteries used to move troops, weapons, ammunition and fuel across the Dnepr river, military observer Alexey Borzenko told Sputnik.

t: Russia Supports US Approach on Talks in Abu-Dhabi on Ukraine Conflict - Lavrov
d: Russia supports the US's approach on security guarantees to be one of the key issues of talks in Abu-Dhabi on the Ukraine conflict, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on Monday.

t: Russia Strikes Dry Port Logistics Center in Port of Odessa - Defense Ministry
d: Russia struck the Dry Port logistics center in port of Odessa, designed for the storage and distribution of cargo for the Ukrainian forces, the Russian Defense Ministry said.
